label: 1. Student - question about the exam
name: Luca Martin
subject: Question about the final exam
body:
Hello Dr. Dupont,

I am preparing the final exam of the Multi-Agent Systems course. Could you tell me which chapters will be covered, and whether we are allowed to bring notes?

Thank you in advance,
Luca

label: 2. Teacher - meeting proposal
name: Claire Bernard
subject: Meeting about the M2 AI jury
body:
Hi Martin,

We need to prepare the M2 AI exam jury of December. Could we have a short meeting next week with the other colleagues of the department? Wednesday morning would suit me.

Best,
Claire

label: 3. Administration - documents and deadline
name: Student Office
subject: Grade submission and internship agreements to sign
body:
Dear Dr. Dupont,

We kindly remind you that the grades of the MAS course must be submitted to the student office. In addition, two internship agreements (conventions de stage) are waiting for your signature on the platform.

Could you also confirm an appointment to review the registration file of a student?

Best regards,
Student Office

label: 4. Research - SuperMASProject
name: Sarah Klein
subject: SuperMASProject - status of deliverable D2.1
body:
Dear Martin,

As coordinator of SuperMASProject, I am collecting the status of all deliverables before the next project meeting. Could you send me a short update on D2.1 and tell me whether Lucas has first results from the routing experiments?

Best regards,
Sarah

label: 5. Ambiguous - workshop registration
name: Julie Morel
subject: Registration for the workshop in Lisbon
body:
Hello,

I am organising the trip to the Lisbon workshop. Could you send me your registration form and tell me if you need a mission order? I also wonder whether the project will cover the travel costs.

Thanks,
Julie Morel

label: 6. Follow-up of email 1 (same thread)
name: Luca Martin
subject: Re: Question about the final exam
body:
Thank you for your answer. Just to be sure: is the exam room the same as for the lectures?

Luca
